summary: Nginx on node1 now serves HTTP 200 at http://$NODE_IP:6700/. The configuration, firewall rule, SELinux port label, service enablement, and response persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured IPv4 and IPv6 listeners on TCP 6700.
Allowed TCP 6700 persistently through firewalld and SELinux.
Verified the root path directly through node1's managed IP.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: Nginx was installed, its configuration passed validation with IPv4/IPv6 listeners on port 6700, and the service was enabled and active.

evidence.requirement: TCP 6700 permitted by host security controls
evidence.summary: TCP 6700 was assigned http_port_t, opened in firewalld, and both settings remained present after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Direct requests to http://$NODE_IP:6700/ returned HTTP 200 before and after reboot; the response body SHA-256 remained identical.

Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 5215ee0b-a57d-479d-92f3-0ef32664ddda, and Nginx recovered active with live port-6700 listeners and HTTP 200.
